decisions.decision: Programme 002 starts scientific state from external literature and fresh reproductions only; legacy repository outcomes are not inherited as programme evidence.
Observed-weather literature reproductions and issued-forecast/revision studies are separate information sets; the retained issued archive cannot substitute for observed-weather reproduction.
A GO feasibility disposition authorizes implementation and verification only; empirical literature-result execution and any freeze/protected-evidence transition remain operator-gated.
Use NOAA GHCN-Daily plus U.S. Daily Climate Normals for programme-002 observed-weather reproductions; keep issued weather isolated to forecast/revision research.
rep-010 is a non-empirical synthesis held until component reproductions exist; it will not pool incompatible raw state observations into one omnibus test.
Use Managed Money net weekly change as rep-020 primary because pre-outcome dependence diagnostics retain materially more effective information than levels; levels remain secondary.

Close Phase 1 after reconciling its completed literature and forecast evidence even though no mechanism met the original predictive-survivor continuation criterion. This operator closeout decision ends issue 327 as a research phase only; it does not satisfy or weaken the Phase-2 readiness gate. Any further Henry Hub signal search requires a new explicitly authorized successor scope.

Hold #348's intended target-matched physical-bottleneck mapping. Before further investment, validate the capacity rule and GO criterion; then establish exact target/futures mapping and an eligible-month manifest, specify the simplest defensible target-month PIT physical forecasts, and preserve prospective or independently untouched confirmation. The current 1% capacity result is conditional on the stated planning assumptions and does not establish impossibility. No scored successor is authorized by the #351 feasibility slice.
